Try it for at least 30 days — This adjustment period lets your body adapt to the new mattress (most people need 60-90 days to fully adjust to a new mattress).

Donation & refund — Avocado will have your mattress donated (it's never resold), and you'll receive a full refund minus a $99 processing fee per mattress. The refund goes back to your original payment method.
